result.stdout:
USAGE:
    pcpm [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    pcpm init
    pcpm add Newtonsoft.Json
    pcpm add Newtonsoft.Json -v 13.0.3
    pcpm add Serilog -p src/MyApp/MyApp.csproj
    pcpm install

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    init                Initialise a pcpm workspace (CPM, pcpm.json, store)     
    add <PACKAGE>       Add a package to CPM and to one or more projects        
    install             Resolve the dependency graph, populate the store and    
                        link to ~/.nuget/packages                               
    list                List packages resolved in pcpm.lock                     
    remove <PACKAGE>    Remove a package from CPM and all referencing projects  
    why <PACKAGE>       Show why a package is in the dependency tree            
    outdated            Show packages with a newer version available on the feed
    store               Inspect or manage the global content-addressable store  
    convert             Convert a workspace to Central Package Management (or   
                        revert with --revert)                                   
    doctor              Check workspace health: CPM correctness, CVEs, orphaned 
                        entries, lockfile sync                                  
    audit               Security and license audit with optional SBOM generation
    ci                  CI-optimised install: verifies lockfile sync, restores  
                        from store, runs dotnet restore

DESCRIPTION:
Add a package to CPM and to one or more projects.

USAGE:
    pcpm add <PACKAGE> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    pcpm add Newtonsoft.Json
    pcpm add Newtonsoft.Json -v 13.0.3
    pcpm add Serilog -p src/MyApp/MyApp.csproj

ARGUMENTS:
    <PACKAGE>    Package id, e.g. Newtonsoft.Json

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help          Prints help information                                 
    -v, --version       Prints version information                              
    -v, --version       Explicit version to pin. Defaults to the latest stable  
                        on the feed                                             
    -p, --project       Add the PackageReference to a specific project file     
                        only. Repeatable. Default: all projects                 
        --no-install    Skip the implicit `pcpm install` at the end

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Convert a workspace to Central Package Management (or revert with --revert).

USAGE:
    pcpm convert [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    pcpm convert
    pcpm convert --dry-run
    pcpm convert --revert

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                    Prints help information                       
    -v, --version                 Prints version information                    
    -r, --revert                  Revert from CPM: restore Version attributes to
                                  project files                                 
    -d, --dry-run                 Show what would change without writing any    
                                  files                                         
    -f, --force                   Apply changes without prompting for           
                                  confirmation                                  
    -m, --merge                   Merge collected versions with an existing     
                                  Directory.Packages.props instead of           
                                  overwriting it                                
        --min-version             Pick the minimum version found across projects
                                  instead of the maximum (default)              
        --ignore-prerelease       Ignore pre-release versions when selecting a  
                                  representative version                        
    -x, --exclude-dirs <REGEX>    Regex to exclude directory segments. Default: 
                                  ^\.|^bin$|^obj$
